entries.reason: Known subject facts are persisted directly as typed Protobuf instead of hand-built JSON.
entries.schema: eve.sensing.proto.WorldSave contains typed subjects and set entries.
entries.version: Binary snapshots write version 2; version-1 JSON is import-only.
entries.migration: restoreJson accepts version-1 documents and validates them before publishing subjects.
entries.unknown_fields: Binary restore rejects unknown Protobuf fields recursively and duplicate subject or set keys.
entries.restore_atomicity: Restore validates into a detached subject map before replacing world facts and rebuilding the optional index.

entries.reason: Binary snapshots are the canonical persistence face; script JSON calls remain compatibility entry points.

trim.absent_profile: No L1-L4 trim claim is made for this persistence format change.

entries.thread_affinity: Capture and restore run on the owning simulation thread without callbacks during publication.
cost_notes: Snapshot and restore cost linear time in subject and set-entry counts.
